meta.description: Medelite is a modern multidisciplinary medical centre in Tbilisi. Outstanding doctors, personalised approach, and quiet attention to detail.

home.specialitiesTitle: A clinic for the entire life of your health, not an acute episode.
home.specialitiesBody: Eighteen departments working in one space, one record, one standard.
home.doctorsBody: Senior clinicians who have been building their practice here — not visiting it.
home.processTitle: A visit in four steps, with time between them.

process.title: You book
process.body: Online or by phone. We confirm a time when both the doctor and the diagnostic you need are available together.

process.title: We meet
process.body: Visits are 40 minutes. Your doctor reads your file before the door opens — not during the conversation.

process.title: A plan, in writing
process.body: You leave with a written summary and next steps, available in your patient portal within 24 hours.

process.title: We keep looking
process.body: Follow-up is part of the plan. For chronic conditions, your doctor reviews your file at agreed intervals.

home.facilityTitle: A building designed around waiting without feeling like waiting.
home.facilityBody: 1,400 m² on four floors. Natural light in every treatment room. A quiet library for consultations. A separate paediatric entrance.
home.galleryTitle: On the other side of the door.
home.galleryBody: Rooms, hallways, objects — in photography. Architecture by Gigi Tsereteli Studio, 2024.
home.testimonialsTitle: We let the patients speak for us.
home.testimonialsBody: Anonymised responses from our 2025 satisfaction survey. Published with permission.
home.faqBody: If you can't find the answer here — call us, or ping us on WhatsApp.
home.ctaBody: Your first visit is a conversation, not a procedure. We'll decide what comes next, together.

services.heroBody: Every specialty at Medelite follows the same disciplines: 40-minute visits, a shared medical record, and transparent pricing published before you walk in.
services.priceDisplayed: Prices are indicative. Final cost is confirmed during booking.
services.ctaBody: Our internal medicine team will listen first and route you to the right specialist.

booking.heroTitle: A visit, in four quiet steps.
booking.heroBody: We confirm your time within one working hour. No automated chatbots.

steps.title: Choose a service
steps.body: Pick a department and a reason for the visit.

steps.title: Pick a doctor
steps.body: Choose from our team, or let us assign the best match.

steps.title: Pick a time
steps.body: See live availability for the next 14 days.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: We send a confirmation by email and SMS.

form.notesHint: Optional. Chronic conditions, allergies, concerns — you can also share these in person.
form.consent: I agree to the processing of my personal data in accordance with the privacy policy.

booking.note: Need urgent care? Call us at +995 32 2 44 55 77 — someone picks up within three rings during opening hours.
booking.summaryEmpty: Pick a service to see a summary.
booking.insurance: We accept GPI, Aldagi, IMEDI L, Ardi, and TBC Insurance. Check with your provider for the exact coverage.

news.heroBody: A quiet newsletter from Medelite. Pieces by our doctors, departmental updates, and patient stories.

about.heroTitle: A clinic designed as a long conversation, not a visit.
about.heroBody: Medelite was founded in 2015 by four doctors who wanted to practice medicine the way they had been taught to — slowly, with time to listen, with one shared record, with the family as part of the plan.
about.missionBody: To give modern medical care a quieter, more deliberate language — one that the people of Tbilisi, and anyone who comes through our doors, can trust with their family's health.
about.valuesTitle: What we insist on, every day.

facilityItems.title: The light
facilityItems.body: Every treatment room has a window. Artificial light is calibrated to the time of day.

facilityItems.title: The quiet
facilityItems.body: Acoustic treatment reduces ambient noise below 32 dB in consultation rooms.

facilityItems.title: The flow
facilityItems.body: Separate entrances for paediatrics and psychotherapy. One patient record across every department.

contact.heroBody: Our front desk answers in Georgian, Russian, and English. For urgent care, call us directly.

directions.title: Metro
directions.body: Rustaveli — 12 minutes on foot along Chavchavadze Avenue.

directions.title: Car
directions.body: Underground parking is free for patients. Entrance from Abashidze Street.

directions.title: Taxi
directions.body: Our pin on Yandex Go, Bolt and Uber is 'Medelite Clinic'.

contact.emergency: If you are experiencing a life-threatening emergency, call 112 immediately. Medelite is not a 24-hour emergency facility.
